method.historical_note: historical note: removed Agent Observer integration is retained only in historical evaluation scripts and backup records; its regression-guard filename in this inventory does not describe an active runtime integration.
method.universe: Git commit blobs before; git ls-files --cached paths with current file contents after. Stage new files before the final run.
method.exclusions: Untracked, ignored, absent working files, and Git submodule trees; no directory traversal and no application imports.
method.line_counts: Physical UTF-8 Python lines including comments/blanks/docstrings; a separate nonblank/noncomment count still includes docstrings.
method.scopes: production=src/**; test=tests/** (including evaluation drivers); support=all other Python files.
method.artifact_counts: Explicit location/extension heuristics classify archived records, evaluation outputs/baselines, and learning assets; classifications do not imply safe deletion.
method.static_analysis: AST imports overestimate guarded/type-only cycles and underestimate dynamic tool/entry-point usage. Candidates cannot justify deletion alone.
method.self_reference: The output file, if already staged, is counted at its pre-write content size; omit its own bytes/hash when comparing repeated runs.
method.line_endings: Byte counts/raw hashes preserve commit or working-file bytes; LF-normalized hashes and modified lists ignore text CRLF checkout conversion.
